profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer who enjoys designing and developing well-crafted and highly efficient solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the implementation of a Web Sales Forecasting System using REST, ASP.NET Web API, C#, AngularJS and MSSQL Server 2014
- Designed and implemented Business Intelligence and Analytics Solutions for ISE Inc and ASE Group using QlikView, MS SQL Server 2014, SSIS and .NET
- Optimized the refreshing of the data warehouse used in the Reporting System from more than 2 hours to less than 5 minutes by rewriting the core SQL Stored Procedures
- Implemented n-tier module to export and import the sales forecast data, giving the possibility to import data using SSIS or a web interface

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Led a geographically-distributed team of 7 software developers and successfully
completed over 30 projects
 - Developed desktop application demo on XNA 4.0 and Microsoft Kinect for Dell Inc. to test
interaction capabilities with Kinect device
 - Created 7 Flash front-end websites on ASP.NET(.NET 3.5 and 4.0) and MS SQL Server
(2005 and 2008) improving product marketing by 50 percent
 - Developed Adobe Air application using Actionscript 3 and AIR 3.4. This facilitated access
to medical information by physicians during conferences and meetings

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a website for a French lottery company. This was a large scale website built
on ASP.NET (.NET 3.5), Flex and MS SQL Server 2008 with hundreds of thousands of
users. http://www.soreglo.com
- Created 2 Flash front-end websites on ASP.NET(.NET 3.5 and 4.0) and MS SQL Server
(2005 and 2008) improving product marketing by 50 percent

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
- Developed Drupal module for network administrators showing use and availability of dialup
modems. This helped monitoring user-connection peak hours and troubleshooting
network problems
- Implemented meta-searcher in PHP 5.0 that it is used in the Infomed portal and requests
information from several end-tools such as Drupal and WordPress instances
- Contributed to managing internet access by rewriting and optimizing Python scripts. This
reduced the overload of a MySQL Server in a 95 % by decreasing the database writing
from more than 1000 times per second to one time every 10 minutes
